div.div: طَنِينٌ an inf. n.: (MA, Msb: [see 1:]) [as a simple subst.,] The sound of flies [i. e. a humming, or buzzing]: and of a basin of brass or other metal [i. e. a ringing, or tinkling]: (S, K, TA:) and of the ear [i. e. a ringing, or tingling]: and of a mountain: and of a hard thing [of any kind]: and ↓ طَنْطَنَةٌ has a similar meaning. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
